htlv-1: HTLV-1 is retrovirus causing T-cell leukemia.
HTLV-1 means the same as human T-cell leukemia virus-1.
html: HTML is a set of tags and rules for using them in developing hypertext documents.
HTML means the same as hypertext markup language or hypertext mark-up language.
http: HTTP is a protocol to transfer hypertext requests and information between servers and browsers.
HTTP means the same as hypertext transfer protocol.
